chunks: And he mentioned from his father, peace be upon him,
That Maymūnah used to say: Indeed, the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, would instruct me, when I was menstruating, to wrap myself with a cloth, then lie down with him in bed.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to the preceding Imam in the transmission
key_terms.أَتَّزِرَ: to wrap oneself with a waist cloth or covering
key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مَيْمُونَةَ: Maymūnah, the woman relating the report

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله instruct regarding sharing a bed with a menstruating wife?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that during menstruation, Maymūnah would be instructed by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله to cover herself with a cloth and then lie with him in bed. It indicates the permissibility of marital closeness during menstruation within the limits observed by the sunnah (prophetic tradition).
